verify_first_findings.question: Are TextSearchProvider / FileSearchProvider finalized?
verify_first_findings.finding: No. src/vscode-dts/vscode.proposed.textSearchProvider2.d.ts and vscode.proposed.fileSearchProvider2.d.ts both answer HTTP 200 at microsoft/vscode main (fetched 2026-08-02). The 2024 rename moved New -> current and Old -> *Old, which is why the finalization threads read as done; they are not. Marketplace forbids publishing extensions that declare proposed API.
verify_first_findings.consequence: V4 is gated. The providers ship inside the pack and register only where the proposal is granted, detected at runtime by the presence of workspace.registerFileSearchProvider / registerTextSearchProvider. Elsewhere the pack registers nothing and VS Code's ripgrep search stands.

verify_first_findings.question: Web output: code serve-web from the fork tree, or carry code-server's patch set?
verify_first_findings.finding: code serve-web from the fork tree.
verify_first_findings.reason: One patch queue against upstream instead of two, and no second auth/TLS layer duplicating the console session auth the pack already speaks. TLS and auth terminate at the edge as the console deploy does.
verify_first_findings.oracle: The V7 web smoke run serving the OW5 workspace container. NOT YET RUN.

verify_first_findings.question: ACP: adopt an existing client extension, or ship thin?
verify_first_findings.finding: Ship thin. packages/theorem-acp already holds client, hosted-client, session-manager, session-boot, bridge, identity, and workspace-state; the pack is only the IDE end. No third-party ACP extension adopted, so no configuration surface or identity path we do not own.

verify_first_findings.question: Product identity for the fork.
verify_first_findings.finding: Commonplace Studio. applicationName commonplace-studio, dataFolderName .commonplace-studio, urlProtocol commonplace-studio, darwinBundleIdentifier dev.commonplace.studio, Open VSX as the registry, telemetry off, updateUrl null. No Microsoft or VS Code marks; enforced by scripts/ledger-gate.sh, which was verified to fail on a planted update.code.visualstudio.com endpoint.

verify_first_findings.question: Patch queue vs long-lived branch.
verify_first_findings.finding: Patch queue, VSCodium shape. build.sh hard-resets the upstream tag before applying, so the patch count means something. Queue is empty at 0 patches.

verify_first_findings.question: Live commonplace-api intelligence surface for the pack (per EDITOR-DX).
verify_first_findings.finding: ABSENT at HEAD. apps/commonplace-api/src/schema/mod.rs builds with EmptySubscription and exposes no diagnostics, semantic-token, inlay-hint, intention, or readiness query. find/scatter (V4) and the workspace revision routes (V3) do exist.
verify_first_findings.consequence: V2 ships against the typed EDITOR-DX contract and its fixture, which is the oracle this spec names. Against the live store the client returns the honest degradation per V1. The surface itself remains EDITOR-DX's deliverable and is not built here.

verify_first_findings.question: Is TimelineProvider stable API?
verify_first_findings.finding: No, and the spec assumed otherwise. src/vscode-dts/vscode.proposed.timeline.d.ts answers HTTP 200 at main and TimelineProvider appears nowhere in stable vscode.d.ts (grep count 0, 2026-08-02). The Timeline view has been in stable VS Code for years; the extension-facing provider never finalized.
verify_first_findings.consequence: V3 takes V4's shape: registerTimeline() registers only where the proposal is granted, timeline is added to extensionEnabledApiProposals, and everywhere else the same revisions are reachable through the theorem.showHistory quick pick so the capability still exists on stable API. Found by the typecheck, not by the plan.

validation.results: tsc clean; 30/30 vitest passing; no-timers gate passing; both bundles built (dist/extension.cjs 48.6kb, dist/extension.web.js 47.0kb); ledger gate passing and verified to fail on a planted Microsoft endpoint.

A grep of the pack shows no interval timers.

test/substrate.test.ts dead-endpoint and 503 cases return level unavailable with the door and status in detail.

items.title: Timeline and local history
items.status: implemented and unit-verified; gated by VF7; restore-to-exact-bytes needs the live substrate
acceptance: Scripted edits to a fixture file appear as timeline entries in order with labels placed between them.
Restore produces the exact prior bytes and itself appears as a new revision.
History is correct with no git repository present.
verification_evidence: src/timeline/history.ts: provider, revision content provider for the diff left side, restore through restoreRevision, plus the showHistory quick pick for hosts without the timeline proposal.

test/providers.test.ts asserts newest-first ordering with labels, the compare command on every revision, and that an unreachable substrate yields 'Local history unavailable' rather than an empty history.
test/providers.test.ts asserts registerTimeline returns [] without the proposal and that showHistoryQuickPick still reaches theorem.diffRevision with the picked revision.
Nothing in this deliverable reads git, so the no-git clause holds by construction.
NOT VERIFIED: restore producing exact prior bytes and appearing as a new revision. That is the substrate's behaviour behind restoreRevision and needs a live workspace substrate to assert.

items.title: Parity fixture
acceptance: The automated comparison passes with divergences enumerated or zero.
The fixture runs in CI and fails on drift.
verification_evidence: apps/console/src/lib/editor-intelligence/cm6-adapter.ts is the console front: line/character to CM6 absolute offsets for diagnostics and token decoration ranges.
test/parity.test.ts decodes each front's output back to line/character with arithmetic local to the test, so the comparison cannot agree with itself.
Both parity tests pass with an empty divergence list at generation 41.
The drift probe passes: a prepended line makes the console front resolve different text and the comparison reports divergences, proving the gate fails on drift.
